beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Riley settles into the chair Dave just left.

options.text: Do I know you from somewhere?

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I've been recording songs on my own for almost a year — just messing around, really. Someone finally heard one and wants to hear more. I don't know if it's actually any good."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: Something you've been quietly growing is finally ready to take shape.
You should have forced it into shape months ago.
This card isn't about something you made.

elaboration: The Empress doesn't care if it's a song or a garden — it just marks the point where something quietly alive is finally ready to be born.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I don't know, calling it 'ready' feels like a stretch — it's still pretty rough around the edges."

options.text: Rough is fine — creation always comes before it's fully formed.
Rough means it's not there yet at all.

elaboration: Creation before form — raw, generative chaos that hasn't settled yet. The Empress was never about something arriving finished.
